# n8n_credential_schema (Data Source)

Reads the n8n credential data schema for a type name.

The body is a JSON Schema-like object from `GET /credentials/schema/{type}`. Unknown types produce a not-found error. Schema shapes include n8n-specific property types and are instance-defined (core and community nodes).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "n8n_credential_schema" "header" {
  type = "httpHeaderAuth"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) n8n credential type name (for example `httpHeaderAuth`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source identifier. Always `schema:{type}`.
- `schema_json` (String) JSON Schema-like object returned by GET /credentials/schema/{type}.
